main_text.l: כַּפְּתֹר m. Malum, Pomum, Malogranatum, sed artificiale tantùm, cujus generis inter pinnacula templorum ac structurarum magnificarum, ornatus causâ locari solent: Globus, Sphærula, Exo.25.33. Amos 9.1. Plural. כַּפְּתֹרִים. Aff. כַּפְתֳּרִיהָ Mala, Sphærula ejus, Exod.25.31. בִּכַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ In malis vel globis ejus, Soph.2.14.

כָּרָב m. כְּרוּב Cherub, Cherubinus, Imago humana, sed alata, operculo propitiatorio arcæ federis imposita, Exo.25.18. repræsentans angelos invisibiles: Unde Moses Angelos, ante paradisum collocatos, Cherubim appellavit, ut populus nomine noto, & quasi visibili, melius comprehenderet Angelos invisibiles, Genes.3.24. Plurale, כְּרוּבִים Exod.25.18. Vide & Ezech.9. & 10.
כָּרְבַּל Pih. Amicire, Tegere: Pyh. Partic. מְכֻרְבָּל בִּמְעִיל Opertus, Paludatus pallio, 1.Par.15.27.
כִּרְבְּלָה f. Chald. Paludamentum, Tegumentum: Aff. כִּרְבְּלָתְהוֹן Paludamentis suis, Dan.3.21.

כָּרָה Fodit, Effodit, Perfodit: Convivium apparavit: Emit, Comparavit: Præt. בּוֹר כָּרָה Cisternam fodit, Psal.7.16. אֲשֶׁר כָּרִיתִי לִי Quod emi mihi, Gen.50.5. juxta Targum & Talmudicos, in Rosch haschana fol.26. cujus meminit R.Sal. Ab.Esra exponit Fodi. Futur. וַיִּכְרֶה לָהֶם כָּרָה Et comparavi eâ mihi, Hos.3.2. וַאֶכְרֵהָ לִי גְּדוֹלָה Et appparavit illis apparatum magnum, 2.Reg.6.23. יִכְרוּ עָלָיו Convivium apparabunt super eum, Job.40.25. Niph. Futur. עַד יִכָּרֶה Donec fodiatur, Psal.94.13. Chal. ex Ithpehal אִתְכְּרִית רוּחִי Transfixus, Infirmatus est spiritus meus, Dan.7.15. vel etiam, Abbreviatus, ut sumitur in Targum, Prov.14.29.

The printed digit in "Dan.7.15" and "Psal.7.16" looks like a 7 but is set in a form close to y; read as 7. The italic and roman split inside the long Latin glosses is approximate.
